evals.prompt: Create a topic with a submit key, subscribe to it via mirror node, and then publish 5 JSON event messages. Write the full Node.js script using @hiero-ledger/sdk.
evals.expected_output: A complete Node.js script that creates a topic, subscribes via TopicMessageQuery, and publishes structured JSON messages.

checks.name: sets-submit-key
checks.description: Sets a submit key on the topic

checks.name: uses-subscribe-method
checks.rubric: The output calls .subscribe() on the query (not .execute()) for live message subscription

checks.name: signs-with-submit-key
checks.description: Freezes and signs with submit key since topic has one
checks.rubric: The output freezes and/or signs submit transactions when the topic has a submit key

evals.prompt: I need to submit a large message (~5KB) to an HCS topic and make sure all chunks go through. Show me how to use executeAll and verify each chunk's receipt.
evals.expected_output: A script demonstrating chunked message submission with executeAll and receipt verification per chunk.

checks.name: uses-execute-all
checks.description: Uses executeAll() to get all chunk responses

checks.name: creates-large-message
checks.rubric: The output creates a large message around 5KB (for example using repeat, Buffer.alloc, or similar)

checks.name: verifies-receipts
checks.rubric: The output verifies each chunk succeeded (for example getReceipt, checking response status from executeAll, or logging receipt/sequence number per chunk)

checks.name: mentions-sequence-number
checks.description: Checks or logs the sequence number from receipts

evals.prompt: Write a script that creates a topic with a 1 Hbar custom fee per message, then submits a message as a different account (not the operator) with a custom fee limit set.
evals.expected_output: A script showing topic creation with custom fees and message submission with fee limits from a non-operator account.

checks.name: uses-custom-fixed-fee
checks.description: Uses CustomFixedFee for the per-message fee

checks.name: sets-fee-schedule-key
checks.description: Sets fee schedule key on the topic

checks.name: creates-separate-account
checks.description: Creates a separate account to submit from
checks.rubric: The output uses a separate submitting account (created with AccountCreateTransaction or clearly configured as a non-operator account)

checks.name: switches-operator
checks.description: Switches client operator to the new account
checks.rubric: The output submits from the new account (for example calling setOperator on the existing client, or creating a new Client configured with the second account's credentials)
